summary: The Marcelo X Guard covers Marcelo Garcia’s entries, sweeping finishes and responses to attempts to dismantle the position.
description: An X-guard course with butterfly and shin-to-shin entries, stand-up sweeps and passing counters.
overview: The Marcelo X Guard devotes its first two volumes to entries, including butterfly, shin-to-shin and collar-and-sleeve approaches. Marcelo Garcia follows these with stand-up, push-back and tilt sweeps, then responses to leg pummels and backsteps. The course also includes the transition from X guard to single-leg X.

guide.display_title: Marcelo Garcia: X-Guard Entries and Sweeps

fits: You want an X-guard course covering both getting underneath an opponent and completing sweeps.

includes: Butterfly, shin-to-shin and grip-based entries, including options against pressure.
Stand-up, push-back and tilt sweeps; leg-pummel and backstep counters and transitions to single-leg X.
limits: Several entries and counters use collar or sleeve grips, so the material is not exclusively no-gi.
